scripts.stt:build: swiftc -O -target arm64-apple-macosx14.0 -framework Speech -framework AVFoundation -framework CoreAudio -Xlinker -sectcreate -Xlinker __TEXT -Xlinker __info_plist -Xlinker native/stt/Info.plist -o /tmp/flow-stt native/stt/main.swift && rm -rf resources/FlowSTT.app && mkdir -p resources/FlowSTT.app/Contents/MacOS && cp native/stt/Info.plist resources/FlowSTT.app/Contents/Info.plist && cp /tmp/flow-stt resources/FlowSTT.app/Contents/MacOS/flow-stt && codesign --force --deep --sign - --identifier studio.saudad.quill.stt resources/FlowSTT.app
scripts.package: bun run whisper:fixrpath && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac --dir
scripts.release: bun run whisper:fixrpath && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac --publish always
scripts.dist: bun run whisper:fixrpath && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.whisper:fixrpath: cd resources/whisper && for f in whisper-cli *.dylib; do o=$(otool -l "$f" | grep -A2 LC_RPATH | grep 'path ' | awk '{print $2}' | head -1); [ -n "$o" ] && [ "$o" != '@loader_path' ] && install_name_tool -delete_rpath "$o" "$f" 2>/dev/null; install_name_tool -add_rpath '@loader_path' "$f" 2>/dev/null; done; codesign --force --sign - whisper-cli *.dylib 2>/dev/null; true
